setup: make -C parchmark-web install-all && (cd parchmark-mcp && uv sync --all-extras --frozen)
on_unavailable: Docker is required for the backend testcontainers suite. On this host the Docker daemon runs inside the vader-incus-docker-host Incus instance and is exposed through an Incus unix-socket proxy at /home/dev/.docker/incus.sock. Set DOCKER_HOST=unix:///home/dev/.docker/incus.sock plus TESTCONTAINERS_HOST_OVERRIDE and TESTCONTAINERS_DOCKER_SOCKET_OVERRIDE (see homelab-docs/vader/incus/vader-incus-docker-host/README.md).
